critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated checks report no confirmed WCAG violations, no touch-target violations, and no viewport or uncontained overflow. However, color contrast is unresolved: axe marks 40 nodes within #injection as serious incomplete findings at every viewport because gradient backgrounds prevent measurement. Measured keyboard traversal/activation and focus behavior are absent; visible copy claiming keyboard operability is not proof. No prefers-reduced-motion test or animation evidence is provided.
critique.fix: Measure text and control contrast against the actual rendered gradient at all viewport states and correct failures to WCAG AA. Add Playwright evidence for complete Tab/Shift+Tab traversal, visible focus, switch activation with Space/Enter, and post-toggle focus/state announcement. Test prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and verify that all transitions or animated reveal effects are disabled or suitably minimized. Retain the demonstrated touch-target and overflow behavior.
